sentences: A pair-oared racing boat carrying two brothers swings around a stake planted in the middle of the river.
John and Barney Biglin were celebrated oarsmen, and the painting shows the halfway turn of a famous race on Philadelphia's Schuylkill River in May 1872.
Spectators line the bank, and the rival crew trails behind on the right.
Rowing was one of America's most popular spectator sports in the 1870s, and Eakins himself rowed on the Schuylkill long before he trained in Paris.
He planned each boat and figure with precise perspective drawings before painting, so the distances in the picture can actually be measured.
